feedback.problem: Find the equation of the level surface for the function $f(x,y,z)={e}^{x-y+z-1}$ that passes through the point $P(1,1,1).$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the value of the function at $P:$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(1,1,1) & ={e}^{1-1+1-1} \\  & ={e}^{0} \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$

Recall that the level surfaces for the function $f(x,y,z)$ are given by the equation

$$
f(x,y,z)=c.
$$

In our case, we're interested in $c=1.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y,z) & =c \\ {e}^{x-y+z-1} & =1 \\ x-y+z-1 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the level surface that passes through the point $P(1,1,1)$ is the plane $x-y+z-1=0.$
